# Fabian Schuh

> Blockchain engineer (Dr.-Ing.) building peer-to-peer infrastructure on Solana — payments, arbitration, mutual risk pools. I believe people can do more together than apart, without surrendering control.

## Pages

- [About](https://xeroc.org/about/): Bio, academic background, research, key projects, hackathon wins

## Projects

- [Tributary](https://tributary.so): Recurring payments protocol on Solana — subscriptions, milestones, pay-as-you-go
- [Accord](https://useaccord.xyz): Schelling-point arbitration oracle — decentralized dispute resolution on Solana
- [Riprap](https://riprap.xyz): Permissionless mutuals — peer-to-peer protection pools, no insurer
- [mash](https://mash.fun): Prediction markets and sports betting
- [Chaoscraft](https://chaoscraft.dev): Collective creation — 1,000 people directing AI agents into one shared codebase
- [Allowly](https://allowly.app): Pocket money for kids and AI agents
- [ChainSquad](https://chainsquad.com): Blockchain and Web3 consultancy
